== Notes ==
* Even if the target foe cannot be knocked down, it still becomes poisoned.
* Synergizes with [[Iron Palm]], as it counts as a lead attack and is also a Deadly Arts skill.

== Trivia == 
* "[[w:Asp (reptile)|Asp]]" is an archaic term referring to a variety of venomous snakes.
